note: AZJ2 collection for I610UES3AZJ2, credits 4uva4ek, BlueScorpioVR, BreadDoesStuff, compdoge, AngelDark92, stearnsbq and CreoleVR. Window Controls replaces standalone Borderless, Rotation and recovery; shared IDs are separate packages.

modules.about: Combined curvature, borderless, rotation and app pins; keep separate window modules off; installs disabled.
modules.test_note: 0.1.70 core reported working on AZJ2; extended idle/wake unverified.
